rows.search_description:
Scott Arfield’s Emotional Ibrox Farewell

Scott Arfield, sporting Rangers’ blue home shirt emblazoned with the 32Red logo and club crest, raises his fist in a moment of celebration and gratitude. The veteran midfielder received an emotional send-off from the Ibrox faithful during the final home match of the season, marking the end of his tenure at Rangers.

Included on Michael Beale’s exit list, Arfield will become a free agent this summer. Pundit Neil McCann praised his service and suggested that Hearts or Aberdeen could benefit from signing the 34-year-old. Arfield himself has stated his intention to continue playing until he’s 40, remaining open to new opportunities as he departs Rangers.
